visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in an indoor aquarium setting with a young girl in a green hoodie leaning over a wooden structure. She is laughing joyfully, her eyes squinting and mouth wide open. In the background, people walk past tanks, and a digital screen displays an underwater scene with cartoonish graphics. (2) The girl continues her enthusiastic reaction, looking at something just out of frame. The camera pans slightly to reveal a screen showing a submarine race game. Background lighting is dim with neon accents from the tanks. (3) A younger girl in a grey sweatshirt replaces the first girl. She grips the wooden rail intently, looking at the screen with a focused expression. She begins to move her body rhythmically, simulating running. (4) Close-up shots of the digital screen show race progress between colorful submarines. The scene cuts back to the girl in grey, who is now breathing heavily but smiling. Other children are visible in the soft background lighting. (5) The girl in grey stands up and points toward a specific area of a large aquarium tank. Her hands are small and her posture is curious. (6) The camera zooms into a close-up of a small, bright orange shrimp crawling on sand inside a well-lit tank with coral and plants. The girl's face is seen reflected in the glass. (7) An animated end graphic appears on a pink background, featuring a cartoon illustration of a young girl with pigtails sitting and waving.

The video captures the excitement of children playing interactive games and their curious reactions to marine life, aiming to share a heartwarming family moment and promote the park's child-friendly facilities.
